entries.title: Numbers 29:1
segments: And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work. It is a day of blowing the trumpets to you.

entries.title: Numbers 29:2
segments: And you shall prepare a burnt offering for a sweet savor to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 29:3
segments: And their food offering [shall be] flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for a bull, two tenth parts for a ram,

entries.title: Numbers 29:4
segments: and one tenth part for one lamb, for the seven lambs,

entries.title: Numbers 29:5
segments: and one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering to make an atonement for you;

entries.title: Numbers 29:6
segments: besides the burnt offering of the month, and its food offering, and the daily burnt offering, and its food offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 29:7
segments: And you shall have a holy convocation on the tenth of this seventh month. And you shall afflict your souls. You shall not do any work.

entries.title: Numbers 29:8
segments: But you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD [for] a sweet savor: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year. They shall be to you without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 29:9
segments: And their food offering [shall be] flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to a bull, two tenth parts to one ram,

entries.title: Numbers 29:10
segments: one tenth part for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 29:11
segments: one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement and the continual burnt offering and the food offering of it, and their drink offerings.

entries.title: Numbers 29:12
segments: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work, and you shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

entries.title: Numbers 29:13
segments: And you shall offer a burnt offering, a fire offering, of a sweet savor to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year. They shall be without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 29:14
segments: And their food offering [shall be] flour, mixed with oil, three tenth parts to every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts to each ram of the two rams,

entries.title: Numbers 29:15
segments: and one tenth part to each lamb of the fourteen lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 29:16
segments: and one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:17
segments: And on the second day [you shall offer] twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot;

entries.title: Numbers 29:18
segments: and their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:19
segments: and one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering, and their drink offerings.

entries.title: Numbers 29:20
segments: And on the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 29:21
segments: And their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:22
segments: and one goat [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:23
segments: And on the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 29:24
segments: Their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:25
segments: and one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:26
segments: And on the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot.

entries.title: Numbers 29:27
segments: And their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:28
segments: and one goat [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:29
segments: And on the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 29:30
segments: and their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:31
segments: and one goat [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:32
segments: And on the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 29:33
segments: and their food offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:34
segments: and one goat [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its food offering, and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:35
segments: On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no laboring work.

entries.title: Numbers 29:36
segments: But you shall offer a burnt offering, a fire offering of a sweet savor to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish;

entries.title: Numbers 29:37
segments: their food offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the law;

entries.title: Numbers 29:38
segments: and one goat [for] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its food offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 29:39
segments: You shall prepare these to the LORD in your appointed seasons, besides your vows and your free-will offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your food offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

entries.title: Numbers 29:40
segments: And Moses told the sons of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
